resources.string: Nightjar streams from any Moonlight-compatible host running on your PC. Start the host and keep both devices on the same network, and the PC appears in your list. If it doesn’t, tap Add PC and enter the PC’s IP address. If it still can’t connect, allow the host through the PC’s firewall.
Tap the PC and keep the PIN on screen. Enter that PIN in the host’s settings or web page on the PC. If the host has per-device permissions, allow this device to list and launch apps.

During a stream, press Back to open the stream menu: keyboard, input mode, overlay, bitrate and disconnect. On a controller, press Start, Back, LB and RB together. Disconnect leaves the game running on the PC, so you can pick it up again, unless you turned on Quit the game when I leave the stream in that game’s library menu. To check a controller’s buttons, sticks and rumble, open Settings, Controls, Controller test. In Settings, Controls, Touch mode, Local cursor draws the pointer on this device, and Touch off ignores the screen while you play with a controller. In the stream menu, Input, Controls for this game places keyboard, mouse and gamepad buttons, sticks, triggers and a D-pad for that game. To bring a layout from Artemis, long-press the game in the library and choose Import game controls. To use this device only as a controller on a host without its own Input-only mode, turn on Settings, Streaming, Input-only on any PC; the PC then still sends a small video stream that isn’t shown.

No video: try H.264 at 720p with HDR and upscaling off.

Stutter: lower the bitrate, connect the PC by cable, or move closer to the router. Use 5 or 6 GHz Wi-Fi rather than 2.4 GHz. If it stutters every few minutes, open Why did my stream stutter? in the stream menu: it spots the rhythm of background Wi-Fi scans.

Input lag: turn on the performance overlay to see where the delay comes from, and keep Low-latency decoding on.

No sound: choose Stereo, check the PC’s audio output, then reconnect.
Share a log with personal details removed. Nothing is sent until you pick an app to share it with.
